note: P repeats the standard 4x5 layout with an orange/dark palette but varies light vs dark, an LCD display and a Backspace row; P4 adds a History panel, which goes beyond basic. Q is four near-identical dark rounded keypads with a black display and an amber/orange accent; R differs more (a 7-segment LCD with a wide equals key, a flat light theme with green operators, a C/CE/backspace row with the plus-minus key moved to the bottom, and a dark glass theme with cyan accents), and none of the three sets break the arithmetic.
